newsitem.title: CHINA: China's Three Gorges to issue 3-year bonds-paper.
newsitem.headline: China's Three Gorges to issue 3-year bonds-paper.

text.p: China's Yangtze Three Gorges Development Co will issue 1.0 billion yuan of three-year bonds with an annual interest rate of 11 percent, the People's Daily Overseas Edition said on Tuesday.

The central bank, the People's Bank of China, has formally approved the issue of the first batch of bonds by the Three Gorges Development Co and the issue will begin on February 28, the newspaper said.
The main underwriters are Shenyin & Wanguo Securities and Citic Securities, the newspaper said.
Individuals, institutions and financial institutions can buy the bonds at approved business outlets, it said.
The Three Gorges bonds can be traded on the Shanghai Stock Exchange.
The China Three Gorges Foundation will act as guarantor for the issue. Investors will be exempt from tax on interest earnings, the newspaper said.
